title: POWERFUL 3AM MORNING PRAYERS FOR BREAKTHROUGH
text: Beloved, I greet you in the matchless name of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. This is not an ordinary hour. This is the hour when heaven touches earth. When the veil between the natural and the supernatural becomes thin. When God visits his people with unusual manifestations of his power. You have not stumbled upon this moment by accident. [music] The spirit of the living God has orchestrated this divine appointment. [music] And I stand here as a vessel, as an oracle of the most high to release words that will [music] shift your destiny from this day forward. The Bible says in Psalm 63:1, "Oh God, thou art my God. Early will I seek thee. My soul thirsteth for thee. My flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land where no water is." There is a dimension of encounter with God that is reserved for those who seek him in the early hours in the watches of the night when the noise of the world is silenced and the voice of the Almighty can be heard with clarity. When you seek God at 3:00 [music] a.m. you are tapping into a frequency where angels are dispatched, where demonic councils [music] are disrupted, where the scrolls of heaven are opened, and where your name is being written in the books [music] of remembrance. The scripture tells us in Isaiah 6:1-2, "Arise, shine, for thy light is come, and [music] the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee. For behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross [music] darkness the people, but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee. [music] Even as darkness covers the earth in this hour, the glory of God is rising upon you. What the enemy meant to use as a weapon against you, God is turning into a platform for your elevation. The very hour that was designed to torment you has become the hour of your visitation. I want you to understand something profound. When Jesus was in the garden of Gethsemane, it was in the night hours that he wrestled in prayer. When Jacob wrestled with the angel, it was at night. When the children of Israel were delivered from Egypt, [music] it was at midnight that the death angel passed over. When Paul and Silas were in prison, it was at midnight that they prayed and sang praises and the foundations of the prison were shaken. There is a supernatural potency in midnight and early morning prayers that causes the gates of brass to be broken and the bars of iron to be cut asunder. The enemy knows this. That is why he troubles many people in their sleep. That is why nightmares come. That is why fear grips the hearts [music] of men in the midnight hour. But I declare to you by the authority of the word of God, every demonic assignment that has been programmed [music] to operate against you in the night season is canled by the blood of Jesus. Every monitoring spirit that has been assigned to your life, every witchcraft operation that gathers in the covens at midnight to program failure into your destiny, I command them now to be scattered by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Listen to me carefully. Breakthrough is not just a blessing. Breakthrough is a violent invasion of divine power into the matrix of impossibility. It is when God shows up in a situation that has been locked, barricaded, and sealed by the principalities of darkness, and he tears down every wall, shatters every limitation, and creates a path where there was no way. The Bible says in Micah 2:13, "The breaker is come up before them. They have broken up and have passed through the gate and are gone out by it and their king shall pass before them and the Lord on the head of them. Jesus Christ is the breaker. He goes ahead of you breaking through every barrier and you follow in his triumphant train. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace [music] with boldness. I thank you for everyone gathered in this atmosphere of prayer. [music] I thank you that you are the God who answers by fire. I thank you that you are the God of suddenly. I thank you that you are the God of the midnight hour. I thank you that no situation is too hard for you. I worship you. I magnify you. I exalt your holy name. You are the ancient of days, the king of glory, the Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle. Let your presence fill this atmosphere now. Let your fire fall. Let your glory descend. Let every heart be stirred. Let every spirit be awakened. Let heaven come down and touch earth in this [music] moment in Jesus's mighty name. Now I decree and declare by the power vested in me as a minister of the gospel of Jesus Christ, every demonic padlock that has been used to shut down your destiny, I command it to be shattered now by the hammer of God's word. Every gate of brass that has stood against your advancement, I decree that the fire of the Holy Ghost melts it down now. Every bar of iron that has held you in captivity, I declare that the sword of the spirit cuts it a thunder. You shall arise and shine. Your light has come. The glory of the Lord is risen upon you. Every satanic delay in your life is terminated now. Every postponement of your miracles ends tonight. Every evil clock that has been used to regulate [music] your timing is destroyed by fire. I speak to every mountain of impossibility in your life. You mountain of death, be thou removed and cast into the sea. You mountain of sickness, be thou removed and cast into the sea. You mountain of baronness, be thou removed and cast into the sea. You mountain of stagnation, be thou removed and cast into the sea. You mountain of depression, be thou removed and cast into the sea. You mountain of failure, be thou removed and cast into the sea. I command you to move now in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Mark 11:23 says, for verily I say unto you that whosoever shall say unto this mountain, be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass, he shall have whatsoever he saith. By the authority of the word that has been spoken, I declare that your mountains are moving now. I don't care how long they have been there. I don't care how impossible they look. [music] I don't care what the doctors have said. I don't care what the bank has said. I don't care what your enemies have prophesied. The final word belongs to God. And God is saying that your season of breakthrough has come. Somebody shout hallelujah. Father, I lift up every person whose finances have been under siege. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 8:18, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant, which he swear unto thy fathers, as it is this day. I decree that the power to create wealth is activated in their lives now. Every spirit of poverty that has been following their bloodline, I command it to release them now and go back to the pit of hell where it came from. Every devourer that has been consuming their blessings, Lord, rebuke it according to Malachi 3:11, every leaking pocket, every broken system, every financial hole. I command it to be sealed now by the blood of Jesus. I speak divine connections into their lives. I decree that men shall favor them. I decree that kings shall be their nursing fathers and queens shall be their nursing mothers according to Isaiah 49-23. I decree uncommon opportunities. I decree supernatural ideas. I decree that the wealth of the sinner that has been laid up for the just shall begin to flow into their hands. According to Proverbs 13:22, every satanic embargo on their finances is lifted now. Every evil covenant that has made them perpetual borrowers is broken now. I decree that they shall lend to many nations and shall not borrow according to Deuteronomy 28:12. [music] The windows of heaven are opening over their lives now. Let blessings pour down. Let miracles pour down. Let favor pour down. Let abundance [clears throat] pour down in Jesus mighty name. I decree and declare by the blood of Jesus, every evil altar that has been raised against your progress is destroyed. Now I am not speaking in metaphors. But the Bible says in Colossians 2:14:15, "Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross, and having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shoe of them, openly, triumphing over them in it. I pray that every arrow that has been fired into your destiny, every enchantment, every divination, every curse, every hex, every spell, I command those arrows to go back to the senders now. Every evil word that has been spoken against you by night, every incantation, every satanic prayer, let it backfire now. Let it return to the sender sevenfold. Let those who have dug a pit for you fall into it themselves. Let those who have prepared poison for you drink it themselves. That healing is not a future promise. It is a present reality. I decree that the healing that was purchased on the cross of Calvary manifest in their physical body now.
